newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - ADRs quiet ahead of FOMC meeting.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - ADRs quiet ahead of FOMC meeting.

text.p: American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) were mixed to lower in quiet trade on Monday amid the prospect of a hike in interest rates at this week's Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting.
Decliners led advancers 305 to 164 in late morning among 806 ADRS. The index of ADRs fell 0.48 percent and volume was 24 million shares.
Traders said markets were awaiting the outcome of Tuesday's FOMC meeting but had already discounted a likely 25 basis point rise in the federal funds rate.

"Most of the overseas markets were overtaken by (the overnight fall in markets in) Japan and are cautious ahead of tomorrow's meeting. It's very quiet," said Andrew Melinek, head of ADR sales and research at NatWest Securities.
Among European shares, Shell Transport and Trading Co Plc fell 1-3/8 to 102-1/8 as takeovers of installations in Nigeria raised worries about cuts in output.
British Sky Broadcasting Group rose 1-3/4 to 61-1/4, and Israel's Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd fell 1/8 to 56-7/8.

Canada's Arakis Energy Corp rose 5/16 to 4-3/4 trade after its chief executive said the company might be vulnerable to a takeover attempt. Arakis announced on Friday a plan to protect its shareholders.
Among Latin American shares, Telefonos de Mexico fell 1/2 to 39-3/8.
